name: 14272-loradecode-phi4mm5.6b-1gpu
model: microsoft/Phi-4-multimodal-instruct, served with the vision-lora adapter bundled in the same repository (rank 256) attached to every request
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1)
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine -- Phi4MMForCausalLM asserts a tensor- and pipeline-parallel world size of 1 in its own constructor, so no other topology builds.
architecture: Phi4MMForCausalLM, ~5.6B: 32 decoder layers, hidden 3072, intermediate 8192, 24 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, longrope out to 131072, bfloat16, 11.15 GB of safetensors; the adapter is r=256, alpha 512, over qkv_proj, o_proj, gate_up_proj and down_proj on every layer.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 12 requests (three full waves of the width-4 loop) with a 3600 s safety cap, static seed 14272.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`: 4096 prompt tokens in, 2048 tokens out, one turn, prompts drawn fresh per request with no shared prefix, every request routed through the adapter.
purpose: A multimodal assistant on one GPU writing long answers from long image-aware prompts for four concurrent users.
launch:
# vLLM at commit ec79b67c77d57d350709a9ea35ebc9314481994a (v0.7.3-227-gec79b67c77), stood up from a
# per-commit wheel, so the engine is named by path in configs/env.yaml rather than by version.
# V0 engine: VLLM_USE_V1 defaults to 0 at this commit and nothing here sets it -- leave it unset.
# max-lora-rank is forced by the bundled adapter (r=256); this engine's default of 16 raises here.
# trust-remote-code is forced by the checkpoint's auto_map -- without it the config will not load.

model: microsoft/Phi-4-multimodal-instruct
trust-remote-code: true
enable-lora: true
max-lora-rank: 256
max-loras: 1

# Forced by the checkpoint, not a tuning choice. With LoRA enabled the engine builds
# embed_tokens at `config.vocab_size + lora_extra_vocab_size`; the default 256 makes that
# 200320 against the checkpoint's 200064 rows, and the load fails on a size mismatch before
# the engine exists. The bundled vision-lora declares `modules_to_save: []` and targets only
# qkv_proj/o_proj/gate_up_proj/down_proj, so it carries no extra vocabulary and reserving
# none loses nothing. 0 is inside `possible_lora_extra_vocab_size` at this commit.
lora-extra-vocab-size: 0
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
enable-prefix-caching: false
